post_meta.author: sierra_wanderer
post_meta.title: Duck Pass 6/9
post_meta.text: Duck 6/9. Snow from about a mile below the pass, continuous but mellow, no traction used just careful steps in the morning crust. Cornice at the top is small and easy to skirt on the left. Duck Lake still half frozen. Mammoth Creek crossings no problem.

conflicts: Sensors suggest more snow than parties on the ground do (severity 3.0 vs 0.7).

post_meta.author: meadowfire_m
post_meta.title: Duck Pass day trip
post_meta.text: Duck Pass yesterday from Coldwater. Trail is clear the whole way, one tiny snow bank right at the pass that you walk around. Duck Lake outlet is high but rock hoppable. Mosquitoes are the real hazard now, bring your head net.

detail.author: meadowfire_m

extraction.quote_span: one tiny snow bank right at the pass that you walk around

detail.quote: one tiny snow bank right at the pass that you walk around
detail.text: Duck Pass yesterday from Coldwater. Trail is clear the whole way, one tiny snow bank right at the pass that you walk around. Duck Lake outlet is high but rock hoppable. Mosquitoes are the real hazard now, bring your head net.

detail.author: sierra_wanderer

extraction.quote_span: continuous but mellow, no traction used just careful steps in the morning crust

detail.text: Duck 6/9. Snow from about a mile below the pass, continuous but mellow, no traction used just careful steps in the morning crust. Cornice at the top is small and easy to skirt on the left. Duck Lake still half frozen. Mammoth Creek crossings no problem.
